Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly concluded that Rebecca failed to provide Micah with a gift. While the document indicated that Micah did not receive a gift aligned with his interests, the Orchestrator assumed Rebecca was responsible without verifying all other employee assignments and gift exchanges. This premature conclusion ignored the possibility of errors elsewhere in the chain, such as misassignment or misreporting of gifts, leading to an unsupported resolution of the problem.
